basic_info.description: Mid-Century Gem with Stunning Views in Miraloma Park. Centrally located in Miraloma Park, this stunning Mid-Century home offers breathtaking views of the East Bay and an abundance of natural light. Designed with a desirable reverse floor plan, the main level features an inviting open-concept living and dining area perfect for entertaining by the cozy fireplace while taking in the scenery. The charming kitchen has great functionality with a lightwell that offers great light and stainless steel appliances for a modern look.The home includes two well-appointed bedrooms and a full bathroom with skylights on the main level. Downstairs, a versatile lower level offers endless possibilities, featuring a spacious family/media room with a wet bar, an ensuite bedroom with a full bathroom, and a sunlit covered porch. Step outside onto two private decks that seamlessly extend indoor-outdoor living, leading to a serene and secluded garden oasis. Additional highlights include a one-car garage, a dedicated laundry area, and a sub-basement with ample storage. Ideally located near public transportation, freeway access, top-rated schools, and vibrant shopping and dining options at West Portal and The Castro, this home is a rare find in one of San Francisco's most sought-after neighborhoods.
